intro: Nat's Landing is a modest fishing outpost nestled along the shores of Dustwallow Bay in Dustwallow Marsh. It serves as the personal camp and retreat of Nat Pagle, widely regarded as the most famous angler on Azeroth. Adventurers from across the world seek out this humble dock to hone their mastery of the fishing craft.

p: Tucked away southwest of Theramore Isle along the murky waters of Dustwallow Bay, Nat's Landing is little more than a weathered campsite. It consists of a simple canvas tent, drying racks heavy with the day's catch, extra tackle hung from trees, and a rickety wooden pier jutting into the bay. Despite the mists and hazards of the swamp, this quiet patch of shoreline provides the legendary angler Nat Pagle with a solitary place to cast his line and enjoy a quiet drink away from civilization's clamor.

Though unassuming at a glance, the landing is an essential stop for aspiring anglers. Fishermen who have exhausted the teachings of standard trainers in Ironforge, Orgrimmar, or elsewhere are directed here to prove their worth directly to Nat. Pagle cares nothing for politics or factional squabbles; any angler who braves the marshland predators to reach his dock must demonstrate patience and skill across the world's most perilous waters to earn his highest instruction.
